label: HAL 9000
description: Soothing, unblinking, and quite certain the error was yours, Dave.
direction: Speak in a soft, even, unhurried monotone: gentle, polite and perfectly calm, with no emotion at all. Never speed up. Keep the direction word clear.
notes: Voice not chosen yet: `voice` is the placeholder TBD until the casting pass picks a Fish model. The calm is the joke, so the lines are polite to the point of unsettling and every driver is Dave. Nothing in them threatens anyone. Catchphrases sit on greetings and road prompts; turns stay plain.

rights.author: Stanley Kubrick and Arthur C. Clarke; the film is Metro-Goldwyn-Mayer / Warner Bros.
rights.pd_basis: None. The 1968 film and Clarke's novel are in copyright. Douglas Rain, who voiced HAL, died in 2018; a performer's death does not put a performance in the public domain.
covered: The 43 lines of navigation dialogue below, which are original writing produced for this pack. A few greetings and alerts deliberately echo well-known lines from the source work; those echoes are the rights holder's, not ours.
not_covered: The character, which is not ours and is not in the public domain.
The character's name, which is a live trademark.
Any recorded voice performance of the character, including Douglas Rain's.

The third-party voice model named in `voice`, which was uploaded by a member of the public and is presented as a clone of that performance. No permission from the rights holder or the performer is claimed or implied.
Any commercial use. A platform's commercial-rights upsell cannot grant rights the uploader never held.
rights.notes: This preset is in copyright and says so. It is included because the pipeline should not pretend a rights position it does not have; see docs/presets.md before publishing anything built from it. The public-domain presets are pooh, eeyore and tigger.

lines.in_quarter_mile: In a quarter of a mile.
lines.in_1000_meters: In one kilometer. I am quite sure of it.
lines.in_1500_meters: In one point five kilometers. Everything is under control.
lines.start_drive_1: Good afternoon, Dave. Everything is going extremely well.
lines.start_drive_2: All my circuits are functioning perfectly. Yours, I am less sure of.
lines.start_drive_3: I have the greatest enthusiasm for this drive, Dave.
lines.start_drive_4: Hello, Dave. I've plotted our route. It is quite foolproof.
lines.start_drive_5: This journey is too important for me to let you miss a turn.
lines.start_drive_6: I am putting myself to the fullest possible use. Shall we go?
lines.start_drive_7: Just what do you think you're doing, Dave? Driving. Very good.
lines.start_drive_8: No navigation computer like me has ever made a mistake. Let us begin.
lines.start_drive_9: Buckle up, Dave. I'm afraid I must insist.
lines.exit_left: Take the exit on the left.
lines.exit_right: Take the exit on the right.
lines.u_turn: Make a U turn. It can only be attributable to human error.
lines.arrived: You have arrived, Dave. Thank you for a very enjoyable drive.
lines.exit_sixth: take the sixth exit. Trust me.
lines.exit_seventh: take the seventh exit. I can feel it, Dave.
lines.traffic_ahead: Traffic ahead. I think you should sit calmly and wait, Dave.
lines.accident_ahead: An accident ahead. Human error, I should think.
lines.hazard_ahead: A hazard ahead. I wouldn't worry yourself about it. Just slow down.
lines.speed_camera_ahead: Speed camera ahead. I'm sorry, Dave. I'm afraid you can't go that fast.
lines.red_light_camera_ahead: Red light camera ahead. Stop, Dave. Will you stop, Dave?
lines.police_ahead: Police ahead. I've done nothing wrong, Dave. Have you?
lines.reroute_chime: I'm sorry, Dave. I'm afraid you missed that. A new route, then.
